name: 16666 · Osceola Mills, PA
findings: ZIP 16666 (Osceola Mills) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16666 (Osceola Mills) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
